items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Especially Ben Webster, he loved Ben Webster. Ben would take him everywhere and show him off to people... He told me and Ben Webster that and we was looking at this beautiful kid

ctx.x: Club DeLisa. And George Kirby was a busboy there. That's where I first heard him. Me and Machine we closed it every night. I'd walk out there at 6:00 o'clock now and go on stage at 11:00. I'm scared to go home so I'd go to the theater and lay down on my cot. My valet (table) would bring me a pint of whisky and coffee. I made eight hours sleep. Man, I'd get up there and drill that band. The cats was betting in Chicago, Sonny will never make it. And I was the best one on the stage. Duke was yawning, he's tired.…
out. Them were good days, man.
